# f5xc_api_credential (Data Source)

Object keeps track of various object credentials downloaded by users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Api Credential - Full

data "f5xc_api_credential" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_api_credential.example.credential_name
  namespace = f5xc_api_credential.example.namespace
}
```

- `name` (String) Credential name Name of API credential object.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace Namespace of API credential object.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `type` (List of String) Type of credential Type of API credential.
